text:
Megan: Quick sync — final draft of the one-pager for enterprise secure deployments (VPC/on-prem + SLAs). Need 3 things by EOD: 1) launch post copy (short + long), 2) benchmark narrative bullets for webinar (latency/cost comparisons), 3) inbound routing rules & qualifying form. Draft here: https://drive.redwood/onepager-draft :eyes:

Arjun: Taking copy. For benchmark narrative let's highlight: p50 50-200ms, p99 120-500ms vs managed competitors; cost/unit ~30-50% lower with batching+quantization. Call out assumptions: avg seq len, batch sizes, and model family. Keep each claim tied to a workload example.

Sam: For inbound — fields we need on the form: company_size, infra_restrictions (govcloud/VPC), latency_SLO_need, estimated_tokens_per_month, compliance_requirements. Routing rules: AE for SLA+Private, PS+Demo for Dedicated interest, nurture for hosted. Add a CISO flag to auto-route to security solutions engineer.

Priya: One-pager layout suggestion: hero w/ 1-line value prop, 3 panels (Security & Compliance / SLA-backed Performance / Deploy Modes matrix). Use icons for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. I'll do 2 hero variants for A/B test.

Ben: Messaging A/B thought: (A) 'Predictable LLM inference for regulated apps' vs (B) 'Ship LLM features with SLA-backed performance'. We'll test headline in launch post and webinar CTAs. Also recommend short-subhead that mentions unit-cost saving.

Arjun: Webinar narrative: 5m product overview, 10m benchmark walkthrough (real numbers + methodology), 10m failover demo (Hosted -> Dedicated fallback), 10m customer Q&A. Slide with a small table: latency/cost for chat workload (avg seq 64), batch default = 8.

Megan: Great. Action items: Arjun = benchmark bullets + 2 launch post drafts; Priya = one-pager mock variants; Sam = routing rules + form json sample; Ben = messaging A/B test plan. I'll consolidate checklist and schedule rehearsal. :thumbsup:

Sam: Routing snippet for backend (draft):
```
if leads.compliance == true or leads.company_size >= 2000:
    route = 'AE-enterprise'
elif leads.latency_SLO == 'sub-200ms' and leads.estimated_tokens_per_month > 1e7:
    route = 'Dedicated-sales'
else:
    route = 'Inbound-marketing-nurture'
```

Priya: Uploaded v1 mocks to Figma: https://figma.redwood/onepager-v1. Files named hero-A / hero-B. Using the new icon set and updated color tokens.

Arjun: I'll annotate benchmark sources in the internal playbook doc and make sure we use conservative phrasing (e.g., 'up to' and include workload notes). Also will add a short methodology slide for transparency.

Megan: Can everyone add final deliverables to the shared checklist by 5pm PT? Rehearsal tentatively Thurs 10am PT. Calendar-bot: pls schedule.

deploy-bot: Rehearsal created: Thu 10:00 PT — invites sent to participants in #webinar-rehearsal.

Ben: I'll drop first-pass launch post copy in here by 2pm for edits. Short + long versions.

Megan: Perfect — thanks team. Let's keep the one-pager concise and metrics-forward. :rocket:
